# LLRT declaration source assets

These `.d.ts.txt` files are byte-identical source assets from the revision in
`SOURCE.json`, distributed under the accompanying Apache-2.0 license. They are
not declarations checked into an application or a handwritten NSH type shim.
`refresh.py` restores the pinned files and verifies their recorded checksums.

NSH's standard declaration generator reads these sources, retains only their
ambient module bodies, and projects the runtime module's actual export names.
Only `.nsh/types`, generated by NSH, contains usable `.d.ts` files. Unsupported
upstream value exports are type-only and cannot be imported as runtime values.
Native exports without an upstream signature are honestly typed `unknown`.
